personas.description: Adjacent-field ML researcher: knows general ML, deep learning, standard evaluation and statistics; not the LLM-agent subfield terms, datasets or prior work.

likely_misconceptions.misconception: competitive means best or state of the art
likely_misconceptions.corrective_point: several listed references score higher than OpenHands on several benchmarks

likely_misconceptions.misconception: OpenHands is a model or a single agent rather than a platform
likely_misconceptions.corrective_point: OpenHands is a platform on which agents run; scores belong to an agent plus a base model

likely_misconceptions.misconception: reference numbers were re-run by the authors under matched conditions
likely_misconceptions.corrective_point: reference numbers are reported values from other systems with different models and prompting

likely_misconceptions.misconception: success, resolve and pass rates are comparable across benchmarks
likely_misconceptions.corrective_point: each benchmark defines its own metric

reader_questions: What problem does this solve and for whom?
What is the platform made of?
Why were these design choices made?
How was it evaluated and against what?
Is the difference from the references bigger than noise?
What does the paper not show?
venue_expectations: limitations stated by the authors reported first
numbers exactly as in the source
